388YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Bastion, Feroz, Karov, Miaren, Mitwold, Redoubt, Sarvos, Sermersuaq, Spiral and Weirwater. The Senate appointed Slawomir Rabovich Bolotstrazh as Imperial Consul, along with an ambassador to Asavea and the generals of eleven armies. The Synod chose Cardinals of Courage, Pride and Wisdom, an Imperial Inquisitor and many lesser religious titles, and those Cardinals named their Gatekeepers. The Military Council appointed a Strategos of the Brass Coast, and the Conclave elected two grandmasters. Bourse seats and ministries went by auction and vote, with the Envoy to the Karass drawing 1300 votes. Sodalities filled titles including High Bard of the Empire.

n.Dawn: Dawn's senate seat for Weirwater went to Tristan duLac at this summit.
n.Grendel: Garviel i Abrira i Erigo was returned as Senator for Feroz, the territory Grendel held at the time.
n.Highguard: Merari Navigators of Virtue was elected Senator for Bastion, Highguard's territory.
n.Navarr: Rhisiart Dancewalker took the senate seat for the Navarr territory of Miaren.
n.The League: The League saw two senate seats filled: Laurencio Lemmini di Sarvos for Sarvos and Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian for Spiral.
n.The Marches: Mary Birchsmith was elected Senator for Mitwold, the Marcher territory.
n.Urizen: Thalia of Netherwatch won the senate seat for the Urizen territory of Redoubt.
n.Varushka: Morana Vesnayevich was chosen as Senator for Karov, Varushka's territory.
n.Wintermark: Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer was elected Senator for Sermersuaq, Wintermark's territory.

t.Bastion: Bastion returned Merari Navigators of Virtue as its senator.
t.Feroz: Feroz returned Garviel i Abrira i Erigo as its senator.
t.Karov: Karov returned Morana Vesnayevich as its senator.
t.Miaren: Miaren returned Rhisiart Dancewalker as its senator.
t.Mitwold: Mitwold returned Mary Birchsmith as its senator.
t.Redoubt: Redoubt returned Thalia of Netherwatch as its senator.
t.Sarvos: Sarvos returned Laurencio Lemmini di Sarvos as its senator.
t.Sermersuaq: Sermersuaq returned Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer as its senator.
t.Spiral: Spiral returned Genoveva Barossa d'Apulian as its senator.
t.Weirwater: Weirwater returned Tristan duLac as its senator.

r.Spiral/Apulus: Mentioned in passing: Apulus appears only in personal names, such as Paris of Apulus, who won the Second Imperial Wayleave for 15 thrones, and several holders surnamed d'Apulian.

388YE Summer Solstice Military Council o.d: Thirty-two armies received orders. Twelve, drawn from the Marches, Brass Coast, Dawn, Highguard, Imperial Orcs, League and Wintermark, converged on Jotun-held Bregasland to reclaim it for the Marchers. Six armies from Dawn, Navarr, Urizen and Varushka struck the Salt Flats of Sanath, with Lower Saarnath and the Sydathian Fens named as targets. Six armies went to Mareave to fight the Grendel. The Drakes and the Star Forged made an overwhelming assault on Madruga, and the Golden Axe did the same in Therunin. Four armies took up positions in Zenith and the Boyar's Hasta rested in Ossium. Dame Aurum De Castellan issued her final orders to the Eastern Sky.

n.Dawn: Dawn's four armies were split across three fronts: the Golden Sun advanced into Bregasland, the Eastern Sky went to Mareave under its general's final orders, and the Gryphon's Pride and Lions of Adelmar attacked the Salt Flats of Sanath.
n.Druj: Six Imperial armies attacked the Druj in the Salt Flats of Sanath, and their generals' orders spoke openly of the end of the Buruk Tepel.
n.Grendel: Six Imperial armies went to Mareave to strike at, wound and hold back the Grendel there.
n.Highguard: The Valiant Pegasus pressed its crusade into Bregasland, while the Granite Pillar and Seventh Wave defended Mareave against the Grendel. The Pilgrim's Defiance gave ground in Zenith on a pilgrimage to Damakan's Forge.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Autumn Hammers raised the Glass Labyrinth in Bregasland, the Winter Sun made hit-and-run attacks on the Grendel in Mareave, and the Summer Storm rested and trained in Zenith.
n.Jotun: Twelve Imperial armies converged on Jotun-held Bregasland to drive them out and reclaim the Marchers' homes.
n.Navarr: The Black Thorns and Quiet Step attacked the Druj in the Salt Flats of Sanath, while the newly raised Star Forged joined the Drakes in an overwhelming assault on Madruga.
n.The Brass Coast: The Burning Falcon made a triumphant charge and the Red Wind Corsairs a daring raid in Bregasland, and the Fire of the South force-marched to Mareave in support of the Imperial Orcs.
n.The League: The Sparrows Reckoning marched from Tassato to Bregasland, the Wolves of War advanced in Mareave, and the Towerjacks held Zenith.
n.The Marches: Three Marcher armies fought to reclaim Bregasland alongside allies from across the Empire, while the Drakes, under a new general, assaulted Madruga in return for Freeborn loyalty.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: the Boyar's Hasta's general vowed that the army would spill Thule blood when the time was right.
n.Urizen: The Citadel Guard made an onrushing storm on the Salt Flats of Sanath, aimed at Lower Saarnath, while the Argent Sword held Zenith and sought riches beneath Kaspoena's Reach.
n.Varushka: The Golden Axe assaulted Therunin and the Northern Eagle infiltrated the Sydathian Fens, while the Boyar's Hasta rested in Ossium after the death of General Alderei.
n.Wintermark: All three Wintermark armies went to Bregasland: the Bloodcloaks to recover the lost, the Green Shield to fight with honour and the Narwhal's Spear to seek the foe.

t.Bastion: Mentioned in passing: the Pilgrim's Defiance set out from Bastion for Zenith.
t.Bregasland: Twelve Imperial armies, including the Strong Reeds already in the territory, attacked the Jotun here with a range of actions from steady conquest to the Glass Labyrinth.
t.Hercynia: Mentioned in passing: the Star Forged were ordered to descend from the heights of Hercynia into Madruga.
t.Kallavesa: Mentioned in passing: the Tusks and the Narwhal's Spear marched from Kallavesa to Bregasland.
t.Madruga: The Drakes and the Star Forged made an overwhelming assault to bring Madruga's untamed parts back into the Empire, having been warned of the land's Spring and Night magic.
t.Mareave: Six Imperial armies fought the Grendel here, through strategic defence, guarding the gates, hit-and-run raids, a grinding advance and a traverse of the crossroads.
t.Mitwold: Mentioned in passing: several armies marched from Mitwold to Bregasland and Madruga, and the Burning Falcon's orders spoke of reclaiming it as the Jotun quit Imperial lands.
t.Mournwold: Mentioned in passing: the Bounders marched from the Mournwold, and its earlier liberation was recalled in two generals' orders.
t.Ossium: The Boyar's Hasta rested here under Hospitality of the Boyars, and the Gryphon's Pride set out from Ossium for the Salt Flats.
t.Reikos: Mentioned in passing: the Granite Pillar's orders honoured the Imperial Orcs who bled to reclaim Reikos.
t.Salt Flats of Sanath: Six Imperial armies attacked the Druj here, from pushing the line and steady conquest to an onrushing storm and infiltration.
t.Sarangrave: Mentioned in passing: five armies, including the Granite Pillar, Black Thorns, Citadel Guard and Golden Axe, set out from Sarangrave.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: the Eastern Sky and the Lions of Adelmar marched from Semmerholm.
t.Tassato: Mentioned in passing: the Sparrows Reckoning, addressed as Bravos of Tassato, marched from Tassato to Bregasland.
t.Therunin: The Golden Axe made an overwhelming assault on Therunin to show its people they were not forgotten, rejecting the false hope offered by Blood-on-the-Snow.
t.Upwold: Mentioned in passing: the Burning Falcon marched from Upwold to Bregasland.
t.Zenith: The Summer Storm, Towerjacks and Argent Sword held Zenith in solid defence and the Pilgrim's Defiance gave ground here, while three other armies departed for other fronts.

r.Bregasland/Ottermire: The Golden Sun planned to advance through the Rushes and Ottermire, while the Strong Reeds aimed to push the Jotun back to Ottermire.
r.Salt Flats of Sanath/Lower Saarnath: The Quiet Step and the Citadel Guard made for Lower Saarnath, with the Citadel Guard aiming to soften Leen and ruin the Beacon of Iskrid.
r.Salt Flats of Sanath/Sydathian Fens: The Northern Eagle infiltrated the Sydathian Fens, hunting for the Druj's weakness among their effigies and monuments.

388YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.d: The Senate raised the fourth Navarr and Varushkan armies and the fifth Marcher army, but the fourth Wintermark army failed. With the Emperor's ratification it created the crime of Moral Injury and limited proscription statements to a Cardinal's elevation. Idolatry was redefined. The Laroc Tourney Grounds were ceded to Rhianos, and tariffs with the Sarcophan Delves and the Sumaah Republic were set to mercantile. Commissions included the Beoraidh Docks, a Barrens wayhouse and the Wrangler's Market. The Palace of Apulian was to be upgraded to the Palace of Mists. Sławomir Rabovich Bolotstrazh became Imperial Consul and embargoed Zemelslo, which closed Radosmo to Imperial fleets in return. The Spark of Ignition sinecure was abrogated.

n.Grendel: The Senate moved to elect an Ambassador to the Grendel, with the title to be appointed at the first Senate session of the Autumn Equinox 388YE.
n.Highguard: The Grand Inspiration of the Way was amended twice, adding seven serene gardens funded with 50 thrones and a Choristers' Balcony meant to bring Highborn cantors to it. Research was also commissioned into the Dauntless Light chapter's conflict with the Child of Faithless Grief.
n.Navarr: The fourth Navarr army was raised in Oakways, Miaren, to fight the vallorn with the support of an eternal, and a Navarr wayhouse was commissioned in Murderdale in the Barrens. The Nightingale Chorus wayhouse was built in Grovesyard, Astolat, and the Dancer's Rest in Serenael, Miaren, was refined with inspirational art.
n.The League: Spiral gained the Palace of Mists upgrade, the Northern Way and new edifices in Apulian. Tassato gained Martim de Tassato's Clattering Curtain Theatre and the proposed Publishing Clearing House in Mestra. Temeschwar's senator also secured mercantile tariffs with the Sarcophan Delves.
n.Urizen: Herminius of Urizen was appointed Ambassador to Asavea. The Spark of Ignition mana sinecure, announced by the Crystal Architect of the Spires with its title to be appointed by Urizen senators, was abrogated by the Senate.
n.Varushka: The fourth Varushkan army was raised in Karsk, and Sławomir Rabovich Bolotstrazh became Imperial Consul and embargoed Zemelslo. Karsk's senator proposed the crime of Moral Injury, and the Wyrding Tower ministry was commissioned in Livardz, Volodmartz.
n.Wintermark: The motion to raise a fourth Wintermark army in Kallavesa failed. However, Bears Rest was built as a mana sinecure in Northspires, Hahnmark, and Wintermark senators secured the Beoraidh Docks commission and appraisals of the Suranni armies and of spreading the Way.

t.Spiral: The Palace of Apulian was to be upgraded to the Palace of Mists, making sea attacks harder and raising Spiral's taxes by five thrones a season. The Northern Way great work was begun to give safe passage from the city of Apulian to Zenith.

r.Spiral/Apulus: Two edifices were commissioned in Apulus: a statue honouring the researchers killed by the Whisper Gallery, and the Wayward House apartments in the city of Apulian to host Jarmish pilgrims of the Way.

388YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly mandated that citizens forgo the Druj secret knowledge of fear, leaving it open only to Urizen, Varushka and Wintermark. It consecrated Elos Harbour and the Great Chain of Sarvos with true liao, and recognised Barabbas as an exemplar of Ambition. The Heresy of the Spawn was proscribed, while bargaining with eternals was declared not idolatry. Highborn efforts focused on completing the Grand Inspiration in Bastion. Wintermark's mandate targeted the servants of Agramant at Treachers Dagger. Many inquisitions were called, new cardinals were appointed for Courage, Wisdom and Pride, and the Virtue Fund was largely spent on rewards.

n.Dawn: The Dawnish Assembly declared that Dawn would spill no more Montanian blood and paused the civil service's Barrens roads appraisal so the three orc septs there could be consulted. Its Greenwood Manor mandate was enacted over a rival mandate, and inquisitions were called on Earl Temperance of the Groves and Earl Estelle de Sanguine.
n.Druj: Navarr and the Imperial Orcs named Ioan Longshadow and Skywise Rykana to lead the rescue of the Great Forest Orcs from Druj enslavement. A mandate also urged most Imperial nations to forgo the Druj's secret knowledge of creating fear.
n.Grendel: The Synod rewarded the Imperial Spymaster with 12 wains of weirwood to build a base for counter-espionage against the four known Grendel spy networks. Freeborn priests also urged the people of Grendel-held Feroz to trade with the Protectorate of Morajasse.
n.Highguard: Highborn priests pressed to complete the Grand Inspiration in Bastion, calling choristers there and granting the inquisitorial court its next rooms. They also took the Seven Bells to the gardens and named Brother Nathaniel as Custodian of the Greenwatch. A Varushkan mandate for a new Holy City at Bastion was not enacted following the crisis of Vardas.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Imperial Orc Assembly sent Skywise Rykana, seconded by Bloodcrow Meep, to lead its forces into the Mallum to save the Great Forest Orcs. It added Udak's words to the Annals of the Ancestors and demanded that the Marchers return the bones of the Autumn Hammers.
n.Jotun: Marcher priests celebrated Mitwold being freed of the Jotun and named the walls of Meade Bree's Stand. They also urged Bregaslanders to rise up and aid the Imperial armies marching to liberate them from Jotun occupation.
n.Navarr: Navarr swore oaths never to rebuild Hacynian and never to use Surut to burn the Great Forest Orcs' groves, and utterly rejected Agramant's offer over Therunin. Ioan Longshadow was named to lead the rescue of the Great Forest Orcs, while the Golden Axe moved to begin reclaiming Therunin.
n.The Brass Coast: The Freeborn Assembly made defending its borders its highest calling after the loss of Feroz and Madruga. It also mandated that the salvage of the Salt Guard in the Bay of Oran honour the dead, defended the Marracossans' tattoos, and challenged the Spider's Tollkeep.
n.The League: League priests urged patience over the Tassatan Hills ilium mine negotiations and called for a pilgrimage to learn from the Marcher orcs in Mournwold. Merchant-princes were sent to court the Sand Fishers, League bravos were cleared to fight the vallorn, and Estella Lucati was appointed Archbishop of Capodomus.
n.Urizen: Urizen welcomed orcs displaced from Thornfen to settle in the nation and asked its sentinels to prepare for the beast Kroll's return to the Sarangrave. The Elos consecration added Hero's Journey to Urizen lore, and Urizen kept access to Druj fear-lore.
n.Varushka: A Varushkan mandate to help Wintermark master Tsirku was not upheld, and another for a new Holy City at Bastion lapsed after the crisis of Vardas. Inquisitions were called on the Ketsov, on Radomir over the Wolf Carousel, and on Boyar Sigismund, and Varushka remained one of the nations allowed to study Druj fear-lore.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark consecrated the memory of the Fist of the Mountains at Elos and entered Nora Falcon's Light in the Chronicle of Heroes. It offered its knowledge of Blood on the Snow to Navarr and to those going to Tsirku, and sent the Banner-bearer of Atkonaroq against Agramant's servants at Treachers Dagger.

t.Bastion: The Grand Inspiration in Bastion gains a choristers' balcony and its inquisitorial court rooms, and the Stone Library stands ready to publish the Seven Bells archive. A reward to complete Berechiah's Basilica was upheld but no weirwood remained, and the Holy City mandate was not enacted.
t.Feroz: Pilgrims of Prosperity will travel to Feroz, after which the civil service will present an opportunity to restore its people's dignity, freedom and prosperity. Priests also urged Ferozi not to accept poverty wages and to trade with the Protectorate of Morajasse.
t.Karsk: Mentioned in passing: a donation of 1 throne and 4 crowns was made to the Virtue Fund at the counting house of Karsk.
t.Madruga: Mentioned in passing: the Freeborn Assembly cited the loss of Madruga when declaring border defence its highest calling.
t.Redoubt: Because the Elos consecration was not upheld with a greater majority, Wintermark and Urizen armies and navies will not gain improved natural resupply while in Redoubt.
t.Reikos: A writ to consecrate the Memorial to the Silent Bell in Broken Ride to Vigilance was not upheld. A small donation was also made at the Reikos counting house.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: a donation of 1 throne and 3 crowns was made to the Virtue Fund at the counting house of Semmerholm.
t.Tassato: The League Assembly urged patience while the Forge and Furnace Fellowship and the League senators negotiate over the Tassatan Hills ilium mine. It noted that the senators had already given the Tassatan workers an initial recompense.
t.Temeschwar: In a penance, Gancio di Catazar was told to repay the contributors to the Silver Fox mines and to work with the Senator for Temeschwar to commission them again.
t.The Barrens: The Dawnish Assembly paused the Barrens roads appraisal so the three orc septs living there could be consulted. An inquisition was also called on behalf of Dawn and the Barrens into Earl Estelle de Sanguine and the White Butterfly cult.
t.Tsirku: Wintermark dares to master Tsirku and its priests will teach anyone travelling there to resist Blood on the Snow, though Varushka's mandate to help was not upheld. Its mandate also turned the fight against Agramant's servants at Treachers Dagger.

r.Feroz/Morajasse: Following Spring's guidance, the Freeborn Assembly called on the Freeborn of Feroz to trade with their neighbours in the Protectorate of Morajasse for mutual prosperity.
r.Reikos/Broken Ride: The proposed consecration of the Memorial to the Silent Bell in Broken Ride, honouring those who died learning of Druj fear, was not upheld.
r.The Barrens/Heart of Peytaht: The surviving Montanians remain in the Heart of Peytaht with the Great Forest Orcs. Dawn vowed to answer them with words rather than swords, and the Freeborn pledged to protect their children.
r.Tsirku/Warriors' Gate: Wintermark's mandate turns the Hunt the Suaq Wastes effort against Agramant's servants at Treachers Dagger. If at least 5,000 strength supports it, they will be scattered and a chance to permanently sever the regio will arise.

388YE Summer Solstice event schedule.d: On Saturday afternoon, nations held senator elections in their camps: Feroz (Brass Coast auction), Weirwater, Bastion, Sarvos and Spiral, Mitwold, Miaren, Redoubt, Karov and Sermersuaq. Tally of the Votes elections for national titles followed from 3:30pm, including the Vigilant Swan, Arch of the Sky, Stone Smith, Reeve of Drycastle, Northbound Trademaster, Boyar of the Iron Roads and Dean of Runesmith's Caution. The timetable also listed Senate, Conclave, Military Council and Synod sessions and deadlines, symposia, battles, the Grand Tourney to elect the Knight-protector of Summer, the Bourse seat auction and many citizen-organised meetings.

n.Dawn: Dawn chose Weirwater's senator at 2:30pm on Saturday after the grand tourney, and elected the Reeve of Drycastle and Envoy to the Karass at Glory Square at 5pm.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named; Feroz, which it held that season, appears only as the subject of a Brass Coast senator auction.
n.Highguard: Highguard began its inquisition of candidates for Bastion's senator at 2pm, then elected the Vigilant Swan and Cinderpath Custodian at the Chapel at 3:30pm.
n.Navarr: Navarr chose Miaren's senator at 1:15pm, immediately after the standing, and elected the Broker of Treji Wayhouse at the Standing Circle at 3:30pm.
n.The League: The League elected senators for Sarvos and Spiral at 3:30pm by presentation of collected bonds, and chose the Northbound Trademaster and Keeper of the Tome at the Plaza at 5pm.
n.The Marches: Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm to elect Mitwold's senator, and the Stone Smith and Reeve of the Happiston Mana Exchange were elected at the Community Hall at 4:30pm.
n.Urizen: Urizen held a demos for Redoubt's senator from 1pm to 1:30pm, and elected the Arch of the Sky, Quaymaster of the Hesychian Docks, Architect of the Crucible and Custodian of the Bleak Tower near the Net of Heaven at 4pm.
n.Varushka: Varushka began questioning candidates for Karov's senator at 1:45pm, and elected the Granites of Veltsgorsk, Boyar of the Iron Roads, Keeper of the Bonehives and Custodian of the Shchaslyvyy Spile at the Central Hearth at 5:30pm.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark set down jars for fifteen minutes from 2pm to elect Sermersuaq's senator, and elected the Dean of Runesmith's Caution at the Tree of Names at 5:30pm.

t.Bastion: Bastion's senator was chosen through a Highguard inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm on Saturday.
t.Feroz: A senator for Feroz was to be chosen by a Brass Coast auction beginning at 1pm on Saturday.
t.Karov: Karov's senator was chosen by Varushka, with questioning of candidates beginning at 1:45pm on Saturday.
t.Miaren: Miaren's senator was chosen by Navarr at 1:15pm on Saturday, immediately after the standing.
t.Mitwold: Mitwold's senator was elected when Marcher landowners gathered at 1:30pm on Saturday.
t.Redoubt: Redoubt's senator was chosen through an Urizen demos held between 1pm and 1:30pm on Saturday.
t.Sarvos: Sarvos's senator was elected by the League at 3:30pm on Saturday through presentation of collected bonds.
t.Sermersuaq: Sermersuaq's senator was elected by Wintermark, with voting jars placed down for fifteen minutes from 2pm on Saturday.
t.Spiral: Spiral's senator was elected by the League at 3:30pm on Saturday alongside Sarvos, through presentation of collected bonds.
t.Weirwater: Weirwater's senator was chosen by Dawn at 2:30pm on Saturday, upon return from the grand tourney.

388YE Summer Solstice interlude.d: The 350-throne Guerdon went to units supporting the Argent Sword and Summer Storm in Mareave, the Drakes in Mitwold and the Red Wind Corsairs in Madruga, and to those spying on the Thule in the Forest of Ulnak. Military units could aid the Thule Earthquake Drummers against the Druj, map the city beneath Apulian or search for Prince Teodore duSesna, scout or sabotage the scouting of Tsirku, adventure there, or fight the threats in Spiral. Freeborn fleets could raid Leen or support the Wings of Kobol at Free Landing. Rivers of Life lay on Mareave, Hammers of Fury on Hercynia and Tassato. Sarangrave, Spiral, Madruga and Miekarova were touched by other magic, and the Omphalos and Splintered House were completed.

n.Dawn: A Dawnish Assembly mandate by Ser Decimus of House de Bastion let Dawnish citizens convert resources into military units at no cost. Dawnish units could also map the city below, fight in Spiral or adventure in Tsirku, though they suffered from the cold there.
n.Druj: The Thule Earthquake Drummers continued their invasion of the Druj-held Forest of Ulnak and invited Imperial mercenaries to join them. Freeborn fleets were offered a raid on Leen to free slaves, though it would not weaken the Druj war effort.
n.Grendel: Grendel Wind Lord Moraith, who hates the Iron Confederacy, secretly arranged for Imperial fleets to illegally help the Children of Wrecks fight the Wings of Kobol at Free Landing.
n.Highguard: Congregations across the Empire could preach the coming Second Age of Virtue, sending pilgrims to Bastion to help raise the Grand Inspiration of the Way, following the Highborn Assembly's highest calling.
n.Imperial Orcs: Mareave, which they shared with the Grendel, was under Rivers of Life. Guerdon shares went to units supporting the Argent Sword and Summer Storm there, and Frozen Citadels were raised in three of its regions.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: well-supported scouting of Tsirku could reveal any significant Jotun presence and connections to Tromsa or Skallahn.
n.Navarr: Hammers of Fury hastened the mustering of a new army in Hercynia at the cost of two ingots per mine, replaced with warm ashes. Navarr could take a free resource in Holberg after the Splintered House was completed, while Navarr fleets faced a two-rank penalty trading with Axos.
n.The Brass Coast: Freeborn fleets could raid Leen to free slaves or support the Wings of Kobol at Free Landing, where 4000 strength would let them reach the ruins of Atalaya and recover relics of the founding. Hammers of Industry sped the Municipal Docks in Calvos Sound, and the Red Wind Corsairs' supporters received Guerdon shares.
n.The League: Spiral saw the Myriad Market opened in Apulian, a Night enchantment of inspiring dreams, and continued efforts against the horrors of the Black Plateau. League units could help map the city below Apulian, Tassato was under Hammers of Fury, and Frideswide Adelaar van Holberg's mandate eased conversion to and upgrading of businesses.
n.The Marches: Marcher congregations could preach Pride in support of the Marcher orcs. Richard Conscience's mandate made it easier to convert to and upgrade farms, Drakes supporters in Mitwold received Guerdon shares, and Marcher fleets gained a bonus trading at Caitun in Faraden.
n.Thule: The Thule Earthquake Drummers pressed their invasion of the Forest of Ulnak, paying Imperial units mana crystals to join them, while the Empire and the Karass spied on Thule attempts to claim a Black Lotus. Mists now barred all but the ritualists from the Painted Caves in Thule-held Mieriada.
n.Urizen: With the Omphalos complete, Urizen characters could take a free resource in Spiral, and Urizen units could map the city below or fight in Spiral. Sarangrave was enchanted and cursed with Autumn magic, and Pillars of Adamant was added to Urizen lore.
n.Varushka: A Night enchantment shrouded the Painted Caves in Mieriada, the Thule-held region of Varushkan Miekarova, and Varushkan units escaped the cold penalty when scouting Tsirku.
n.Wintermark: Yrkja Riansson Sigeing's mandate let Winterfolk convert resources into military units at no cost, and Winterfolk units could adventure in Tsirku without a cold penalty. Kallavesa received several regional rituals, Talon's Alb was added to Runesmith's Law, and Winterfolk fleets gained a bonus at Caitun.

t.Bastion: Pilgrims inspired by congregations preaching the Second Age of Virtue were to travel to Bastion to help build the Grand Inspiration of the Way.
t.Forest of Ulnak: The Thule Earthquake Drummers continued their invasion against the Druj here, while Imperial units working with Karass scouts spied on Thule attempts to claim a Black Lotus. That effort earned Guerdon shares and could enable use of the Sentinel Gate with 4000 strength.
t.Hercynia: Hammers of Fury hastened the mustering of a new Imperial army here, while each mine produced two fewer ingots but gained a pouch of warm ashes.
t.Holberg: The Splintered House wayhouse was completed here, allowing Navarr characters to take a new personal resource in Holberg for free.
t.Kallavesa: Dripping Echoes of the Fen was cast on Kallavesa Marsh and Rundhal Marsh, and Forge the Wooden Fastness on Wittal Grove.
t.Madruga: Hammers of Industry put the Municipal Docks in Calvos Sound on course for completion by the Autumn Equinox. Red Wind Corsairs supporters received Guerdon shares, and Free Landing was the target of the Wings of Kobol.
t.Mareave: Rivers of Life infused the territory's waters with healing power and reduced army casualties. Supporters of the Argent Sword and Summer Storm here received Guerdon shares, and Frozen Citadels were raised in Clisearn, Icarion and Nadir.
t.Miekarova: A Night enchantment wrapped the paths to the Painted Caves in Mieriada in mists and illusions, so that only those who performed the ritual could enter.
t.Mitwold: Mentioned in passing: military units supporting the Drakes in Mitwold received shares of the Guerdon.
t.Otkodov: Mentioned in passing: Tsirku scouting could reveal connections to Otkodov, and the Ambassador to Otkodov was named as one way the Thule might learn of the spying in Ulnak.
t.Salt Flats of Sanath: Freeborn fleets were offered a raid on the Druj city of Leen to free slaves, with greater strength freeing hundreds.
t.Sarangrave: An Autumn arcane projection of unknown effect and an Autumn curse granting an intuitive sense of danger were both laid on the territory, and Forge the Wooden Fastness was cast in Nesustak Forest.
t.Sermersuaq: Mentioned in passing: supernatural beasts of Blood-on-the-Snow are said to come down from Tsirku into Sermersuaq.
t.Skallahn: Mentioned in passing: Tsirku scouting at 3000 strength could reveal any connections to Skallahn.
t.Spiral: Units could fight the Black Plateau threats in Swords Against Darkness, map the city below Apulian or search for Prince duSesna. The Myriad Market opened in Apulian, a Night enchantment brought inspiring dreams, and the Omphalos was completed.
t.Tassato: Hammers of Fury hastened the mustering of a new Imperial army here, while each mine produced two fewer ingots but gained a pouch of warm ashes.
t.Tromsa: Mentioned in passing: Tsirku scouting at 3000 strength could reveal any connections to Tromsa.
t.Tsirku: The Tsirku scouting network could explore one region a season, opposed by units hired through the Whisper Gallery to conceal its secrets, while Dawnish and Winterfolk units could adventure there for treasures of the wasteland.

r.Kallavesa/Kallavesa Marsh: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on Kallavesa Marsh twice.
r.Kallavesa/Rundhal Marsh: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on Rundhal Marsh.
r.Kallavesa/Wittal Grove: The Coven of the Horned Hare cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Wittal Grove.
r.Madruga/Calvos Sound: Thanks to Hammers of Industry, the Municipal Docks in Calvos Sound were expected to be completed by the start of the Autumn Equinox 388YE.
r.Madruga/Free Landing: Freeborn fleets could support the Suranni Wings of Kobol attacking Free Landing, with 4000 strength opening the ruins of Atalaya to them, while some fleets were secretly enlisted to aid the Children of Wrecks against them.
r.Mareave/Clisearn: Ashen Flame raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Clisearn.
r.Mareave/Icarion: Ashen Flame raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Icarion.
r.Mareave/Nadir: Phoenix Rising raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae in Nadir.
r.Miekarova/Mieriada: Mists, illusions and false lights now lead travellers astray from the Painted Caves, which only those who performed the ritual can enter.
r.Salt Flats of Sanath/Leen Rarckan: Freeborn fleets could sail to Leen Rarckan to raid Leen and free slaves, with outcomes ranging from a botched raid to hundreds freed.
r.Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest: The Coven of the Horned Hare cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Nesustak Forest.

388YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.d: The winds included highest callings for Navarr, Dawn, the League, the Imperial Orcs and several Synod assemblies. Two new national armies mustered, one in Tassato and one in Hercynia. Diplomatic winds covered Jarm, the Commonwealth, Sumaah, Axos, the Iron Confederacy and several orc nations. Eighty fleet captains backed a Freeborn armada of almost fifteen thousand ships that raided Leen Rarckan and rescued thousands of slaves. The Barrens roads appraisal awaits guidance from the Dawnish Assembly. Magistrate Abraham apologised to Claudia Varkulova Remislav. A Grendel band threatened Professor Gelberg in Reikos. Thirty-five minor and five major conjunctions from the Spring Equinox were resolved, including miasma pillars destroyed across the Sarangrave.

n.Dawn: Dawn's National Assembly made the fight against the vallorn near the Barrens its highest calling, and Emperor Vesna addressed Dawn after its victory over the manticore. The civil service also awaits Dawnish Assembly guidance on where roads in the Barrens should run.
n.Druj: The Druj lost thousands of slaves when the Freeborn raided Leen Rarckan. The Imperial Orcs also uncovered a chance to free the Great Forest orcs held at Druj weirwood groves, and several Druj forces and miasma pillars in the Sarangrave were destroyed.
n.Grendel: A band of Grendel Wave Riders posing as Unshackled travelled up the Couros to assassinate Professor Gelberg in Reikos. The Grendel also sent messages to the Empire in the Myth makers wind and faced Imperial heroes at Ohwinn Scour in Clisearn.
n.Highguard: The Highborn expressed peerless kinship with the Brass Coast by studying the firebrand movement in Anduz. Highborn wounded were rescued at Chalcis Mount, refugees were treated in High Chalcis, and Grendel assassins threatened a Commonwealth scholar in Reikos.
n.Imperial Orcs: Skywise Rykana led a delegation to the ancestors of the Great Forest Orcs and learned of a threat to orcs enslaved by the Druj. The Imperial Orcs also proposed help for impoverished Feroz, and Rykana served as field marshal at Ohwinn Scour.
n.Jotun: The Jotun sent messages in the Myth makers diplomatic wind. Lasambrian Jotun and Jotun forces were left unopposed at Meade Meadow and Drayham Mere, while the Lasambrian banner was recovered from Beatriz's Field in Reinos.
n.Navarr: The Navarr Assembly's highest calling urged its people to arm and train the League against the vallorn. The third Navarr army mustered in Hercynia, and Rowyn of the Waystone Path is to decide its name and quality.
n.The Brass Coast: Freeborn corsairs and kohan led the overwhelming raid on Leen, and charitable Freeborn families now care for over a thousand freed people. The Freeborn also faced proposals to rebuild the bridges between Madruga and Feroz, the rise of the firebrand movement, and a chance to consecrate Ahraz's Tomb.
n.The League: The League Assembly's highest calling seeks to bring sapient beings of all kinds into the League and the Way. The third League army mustered in Tassato, Navarr offered help against the vallorn, and events in Apulian and at the Chains of Sarvos offered further opportunities.
n.The Marches: The Marches faced troubles in Mitwold, hauntings in Bregasland, questions over Marcher orcs and the scions of Red Walder. The Meade Meadow conjunction went untaken and the foot-the-ball trophy was lost, but a cache at Maggie's Bulwark was recovered.
n.Thule: The Thule sent messages to the Empire in the Myth makers wind. A report on the Thule conquest of the Forest of Ulnak, alongside the Earthquake Drummers, was made public, and Imperial heroes recovered Thule material at the Bound Glade.
n.Urizen: Urizeni stargazers worked in the Sarangrave on defences against the vallorn of Bendol, and Andronikos of the Lighthouse-That-Was led the warding of the Mantifent Stones. The Synod also intends to consecrate the restored Elos docks in Redoubt.
n.Varushka: Varushka was tagged in the Tsirku mapping effort, and conjunctions in Karov, Karsk, Ossium and Volodmartz recovered the Rat Idol, destroyed a bandit vale and killed the Kallad. Magistrate Abraham publicly apologised to the Winter magician Claudia Varkulova Remislav.
n.Wintermark: The Mediator of Hyljehal made contact with the Hylje leader Koskinen. In Hahnmark, Valdr Grieversson was dedicated to Loyalty, and Hallr Winterborn was killed in Sermersuaq. Winterfolk fleet owners were also tagged in the Pride in the Marches wind.

t.Astolat: The Senator for Astolat oversaw the repair of Igraine's Regio in Withy, and the senator was also tagged in the A wizard did it wind.
t.Bay of Catazar: Mentioned in passing: the Leen raid armada sailed out of the bay into the Sea of Sighs and later returned to its western shores at Oran and Calvos.
t.Bregasland: The Drayham Mere conjunction went untaken, so the Ullsmere Rock was stolen and the Grey Fens became haunted. At Harry's Hole, a yegarra was killed and the Narwhal's Spear was resupplied.
t.Brocéliande: The Knight of the Greenwood's band killed all the hunting ettercaps at Longberth Trod in Elerael.
t.Feroz: Feroz was the subject of a Morajassan proposal to reconnect it with Madruga and of an Imperial Orc plan to aid the impoverished territory. The Brazen Links were reclaimed in Oranseri and the Hand of Dumon was stopped in Afarjasse.
t.Fjorknae: Mentioned in passing: because Meade Meadow went untaken, a warband of Fjorknae orcs has been hired.
t.Forest of Ulnak: A report on the Thule conquest of the forest was made public, and the High Exorcist's band cleared the ghosts at the Bound Glade in Grimfen Mire.
t.Hahnmark: Valdr Grieversson was dedicated to Loyalty at his farmstead in Kronemark. The recovery of a letter at the Fallen Tree in Valasmark remains uncertain.
t.Hercynia: The third Navarr army mustered in Hercynia, with lingering effects of the Hammers of Fury on local artisans. All ettercaps at Greenmount were killed and their structure destroyed.
t.Kallavesa: Ingrid Talon-of-the-Mark's band took part in a hetjuveisla at Gull's Isle Hall, and Grimnir of Wittal Grove was tagged in the Keys of blood wind.
t.Karov: The Senator for Temeschwar's band recovered the Rat Idol from cultists of the Night Below at Maria's Descent.
t.Karsk: Named citizens met Taysa of the Black Feathers in Branoc, and the Apothecaries Guild's effort to treat the Gregadze in Crowslook has an unclear outcome.
t.Madruga: The Oran operation proposes restoring the bridges to Feroz that were washed away. At the Egnar Range in Crucible, dire astacids inflicted Imperial casualties and the Camp of the Sand Crab was left in ruins.
t.Mareave: At Ohwinn Scour in Clisearn, Imperial heroes summoned Iskander's Donjon and fought the Grendel advance. Beoraidh sent diplomatic messages, and the Senator for Mareave was tagged in the Myth makers wind.
t.Mitwold: Pride in the Marches took stock of the troubled situation in Mitwold. The untaken Meade Meadow conjunction cost the foot-the-ball trophy, while a cache from Maggie's Bulwark reached the Bailiff of Meade.
t.Necropolis: Mentioned in passing: Necropolis is not discussed directly on this summary page.
t.Ossium: Imperial units supported the Earthquake Drummers in north-eastern Ossium. In Drownbark Forest, wagon raiders were cured of spiritual ailments and the Kallad were killed.
t.Otkodov: Mentioned in passing: Otkodov appears in the Myth makers diplomacy, and its ambassador is tagged in several winds.
t.Redoubt: The Synod intends to consecrate the restored Elos docks as an inspirational location, built around the last banner of the Fist of the Mountains.
t.Reikos: Grendel Wave Riders are hunting Professor Gelberg in southern Reikos, and Nekoda of the Shattered Tower is charged with his defence. Refugees and wounded Highborn were also aided in High Chalcis and Chalcis Mount.
t.Reinos: The Champion of Ambition's band recovered the Lasambrian banner from Beatriz's Field in Bastasor.
t.Salt Flats of Sanath: A Freeborn armada struck Leen Rarckan and rescued thousands of slaves, while Druj garrisons elsewhere in the Salt Flats were occupied.
t.Sarangrave: Urizeni stargazers sought defences against the vallorn of Bendol, and many miasma pillars were destroyed across the territory. The untaken Feverbank conjunction let vallornspawn attack into Nesustak Forest, and blinded ghosts remain in Thornfen.
t.Sarvos: A chance arose to strengthen the consecrated Chains of Sarvos, and the Hand of Dumon was killed in Uccelini. Some freed former Imperials were landed at Sarvos.
t.Sea of Snow: Mentioned in passing: the Sea of Snow is not named directly on this summary page.
t.Segura: Mentioned in passing: the Freeborn welcomed the Highborn delegation exploring the firebrand movement to Anduz.
t.Sermersuaq: Hallr Winterborn was killed and a banner recovered at Desolate Stretch, and fans of Sermersuaq were tagged in the Hylje wind.
t.Shavronne: Mentioned in passing: the Leen raid armada sailed through Shavronne's waters on its way south.
t.Spiral: The confluence in Apulian reached a crescendo as military units helped map the city below. At Broken Lea, Imperials were repulsed and the Vorlach Adventurers escaped.
t.Tassato: The third League army mustered in Tassato under Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato. Its rival military academies are also staging a tourney for 14 to 18 year olds.
t.Temeschwar: Mentioned in passing: the Senator for Temeschwar was responsible for recovering the Rat Idol in Karov.
t.The Barrens: The Barrens roads appraisal is stalled until the Dawnish Assembly gives guidance, as roads would cross lands claimed by the Great Forest Orcs, the Karass and the Rahvin. Dawn also aims to fight the three vallorn hearts adjacent to the Barrens.
t.Tsirku: Efforts to map the frozen wastes of Tsirku continue in the Warriors' Gate wind.
t.Veroigne: Mentioned in passing: the Leen raid armada sailed through Veroigne's waters.
t.Volodmartz: The Academy destroyed a "bandit" vale in Murupa, and the suffering of the Shadow Fellowship was ended in Livardz.

r.Feroz/Afarjasse: The Hand of Dumon was killed at Abril's Pasture, and the herd of Afar is safe.

r.Feroz/Oranseri: The Corsair of Oran reclaimed the Brazen Links at Sisters' Meadow, and the Leen armada set out from and returned to Oran.

r.Hahnmark/Kronemark: Eevi of the Gadrai's meeting at Grieversonn Farmstead saw Valdr Grieversson dedicated to Loyalty.
r.Hahnmark/Valasmark: The attempt to recover a letter at the Fallen Tree had an uncertain result, and Morgan Drifting Bough should know more.
r.Hercynia/Deer's Folly: The Speaker of the Vallornguard's band killed all the ettercaps at Greenmount and destroyed their structure.
r.Kallavesa/West Marsh: A hetjuveisla took place at Gull's Isle Hall, and those who went should know more.
r.Kallavesa/Wittal Grove: Mentioned in passing: Grimnir of Wittal Grove was tagged in the Keys of blood wind.
r.Karov/Wieliczka: The Rat Idol was recovered from cultists of the Night Below at Maria's Descent.
r.Karsk/Branoc: Named citizens met Taysa of the Black Feathers at the Hall of the Bloodwise, with an uncertain outcome.
r.Karsk/Crowslook: The effort to treat the Gregadze at Skylost Clearing had an unclear result.
r.Madruga/Crucible: The fight against the dire astacids in the Egnar Range cost Imperial casualties and left the Camp of the Sand Crab in ruins.
r.Mareave/Beoraidh: Mentioned in passing: the city-state of Beoraidh sent messages in the Myth makers diplomatic wind.
r.Mareave/Clisearn: At Ohwinn Scour, Iskander's Donjon was summoned and Scutt-Tadgh was taken to Anvil. Some of the Tholdie Rotary were rescued, Fergus Konnaugh was cursed and the Blades of Evdokia were killed.
r.Mitwold/Meade March: Meade Meadow went untaken, so Fjorknae orcs were hired and the foot-the-ball trophy was lost. At Maggie's Bulwark, a yegarra was defeated and the cache was recovered.
r.Necropolis/Longbeach: Mentioned in passing: Longbeach is not discussed directly on this summary page.
r.Ossium/Drownbark Forest: Strange wagon raiders at Sarakov Point were rid of their spiritual ailments, and the Kallad at Nadezhda's Enclosure were all killed.
r.Reikos/Chalcis Mount: The Champion of Loyalty's band killed the ettercaps at South Downs and rescued wounded Highborn, who were treated in Anvil.
r.Reinos/Bastasor: The Lasambrian banner was recovered from Beatriz's Field.
r.Salt Flats of Sanath/Leen Rarckan: The Freeborn armada landed at Leen Rarckan, fought off Druj ambushes in its alleys and freed thousands of slaves.
r.Sarangrave/Bendol: Urizeni stargazers sought ways to defend against the vallorn of Bendol, which had earlier pushed into Nesustak Forest.
r.Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh: At Mantifent's Bier the Mantifent Stones were warded, the Bilious Breath's leaders were killed and two Urizen seers were rescued. The Toxic Pillar was destroyed, and named citizens met the rebels at Dandelion Glade.
r.Sarangrave/Kroll: Both miasma pillars at Kreeflirn were destroyed, with some Imperial casualties.
r.Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest: The Feverbank Trees conjunction went untaken, so vallornspawn attacked the forest and the Envenomed Claws remain a threat. The rebels are recovering, and the fate of the hares of Irra Harah is unknown.

r.Sarangrave/Turan Flats: Sept members were rescued from blinded ghosts at Dahis Outskirts. At Kullflirn, the Druj were killed and the miasma pillar destroyed.
r.Sarvos/Uccelini: The Ambassador to the Iron Confederacy's band killed the Hand of Dumon at Bertolli's Glebe.
r.Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes: Hallr Winterborn was killed at Desolate Stretch and the banner was recovered.
r.Spiral/Apulus: The Imperials at Broken Lea were repulsed, and the Vorlach Adventurers escaped Spiral.
r.The Barrens/Bitter Strand: The Empire ceded Bitter Strand to the Rahvin, so roads through it would need their permission or force. If the Dawnish Assembly stays silent, the default plan would run roads straight through it.
r.Tsirku/Warriors' Gate: The ongoing effort to map the frozen wastes centres on Warriors' Gate, as set out in the wind of the same name.
r.Volodmartz/Livardz: The suffering of the Shadow Fellowship in the Sunless Vale was ended.
r.Volodmartz/Murupa: The Academy found and destroyed the "bandit" vale in the Forest of Blades.

388YE Summer Solstice winds of war.d: Separate Winds covered Madruga (Phantasms and foam), Mareave (Mithril and rope), Sarangrave (Thorn and bone) and the Forest of Ulnak (Who can you trust?). Three battle opportunities were identified, two to be chosen by the generals: containing the dead in Sarangrave and raiding the Druj in the Forest of Ulnak, both against the Druj, and opening the vaults in Mareave against the Grendel. Nations' force weights were listed, with Dawn, Wintermark and Navarr the largest contributors. More than thirty conjunctions were scheduled. Three were described in detail: killing a Druj het threatening Dawnguard, slaying the Servants of the Burnt at a herald of Skathe's request, and destroying a Druj miasma pillar in Therunin. Military considerations listed national orders, mandated border patrols and army bonuses.

n.Dawn: Dawn contributed the largest force weight (67), and its Knight of Dawnguard and Knight-protector of Winter were charged with conjunctions against Druj and Surut's servants in the Barrens. Dawnish armies may not take Cautious Advance, Give Ground or, until Summer 389YE, Steady Conquest against the Druj, though they may use Triumphant Charge against them.
n.Druj: The Druj were the opposition in the Sarangrave and Forest of Ulnak battle opportunities and in many conjunctions, including raids and pacts with heralds in the Barrens and a miasma pillar in Therunin. They need 25 victory points to claim a beachhead in the Barrens, Morrow, Zenith or Ossium because of citizen border patrols.
n.Grendel: The Grendel were the opposition in the Mareave battle opportunity at the Ruins of Sinat. Imperial conjunctions targeted them in Fleisardh, Haros Water, Naris and Wittal Grove, including attempts to poison them and to stop their assassins.
n.Highguard: Highguard offered force weight 27. Its armies may take Protect the Innocent, but lose effective strength if supported by heralds under Frater Pontius's mandate, and they gain bonuses when attacking Zenith from Morrow. Highborn-held Necropolis and Reikos faced conjunctions.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Imperial Orcs contributed the smallest force weight (7), and an Imperial Orc army may take the Forge Hammers order while in Skarsind.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: Wintermark armies fighting the Jotun gain extra victory points but inflict fewer casualties and suffer fewer casualties.
n.Navarr: Navarr contributed force weight 59. A conjunction to destroy a Druj miasma pillar in Therunin's Lower Tarn Valley would protect a region Navarr shares with the Druj, and the Archmage of Spring was tasked with casting Dance of Navarr and Thorn in Sarangrave.
n.The Brass Coast: The Brass Coast contributed force weight 16. Madruga, which it partly held, saw conjunctions to aid a stranded ship from Sumaah and to claim the Snapping Face.
n.The League: The League contributed force weight 26. Its territories saw conjunctions to intercept mercenaries' pay in Spiral and to kill heralds of Siakha in Tassato.
n.The Marches: The Marches contributed force weight 26. Marcher armies cannot Give Ground but gain extra strength in their home territories, any Imperial army may Billet in Mitwold, Mournwold or Upwold, and conjunctions sought to protect the Maiden Stone and Golden Fields in Mitwold.
n.Urizen: Urizen contributed force weight 13. Herminius's mandate set citizens patrolling the borders of Morrow and Zenith, Urizen armies gain bonuses attacking Zenith from Morrow, and a conjunction in Redoubt sought to leave no more than a dozen Grendel alive.
n.Varushka: Varushka contributed force weight 18. Velko's mandate set citizens patrolling Ossium, where Varushkan armies may take Hospitality of the Boyars, and conjunctions aimed to prevent the cursing of Ossium and destroy the Sumisev Peegel in Volodmartz.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark contributed force weight 65. Its armies may Fight with Honour and gain modifiers against the Jotun, and conjunctions in Kallavesa sought to consecrate the Meeting Place and defeat the Grendel at Frithstan's Fen.

t.Astolat: The Senator for Astolat was tasked with a conjunction to discover why Igraine's Regio in Withy kept shifting back to Spring, and to resolve it.
t.Bregasland: The Strong Reeds receive an additional 1000 strength when fighting in Bregasland, then held by the Jotun.
t.Brocéliande: Mentioned in passing: the Druj band threatening Dawnguard burst out of Brocéliande.
t.Forest of Ulnak: The Forest of Ulnak had its own Wind, a possible battle to raid the Druj at the Fetid Heart, and conjunctions in Grimfen Mire and Gloomsea.
t.Kallavesa: Kallavesa saw conjunctions to consecrate the Meeting Place in West Marsh and to defeat the Grendel in Wittal Grove.

t.Mareave: Mareave had its own Wind, Mithril and rope, and a possible Sunday battle against the Grendel at the Ruins of Sinat. A conjunction in Fleisardh aimed to poison the Grendel.
t.Mitwold: Conjunctions in Maiden Downs sought to stop the cursing of the Maiden Stone and the burning of Golden Fields. Imperial armies may Billet there, and the Drakes gain strength fighting in Mitwold.
t.Morrow: Citizens patrol Morrow's borders, so the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead. Highborn and Urizen armies gain bonuses attacking Zenith from Morrow or defending Morrow against attacks from Zenith.
t.Mournwold: Any Imperial army may Billet in Mournwold, and the Tusks receive an additional 1000 strength when fighting there.
t.Necropolis: The Guardian of Britta's Memorial was tasked with spilling the waters of Siakha at the Veiled Garden in Coursmouth.
t.Ossium: A conjunction sought to prevent the cursing of Ossium. Citizen patrols mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead, and Varushkan armies may take Hospitality of the Boyars there.
t.Redoubt: Telemachus of the Lighthouse-That-Was was tasked with leaving no more than a dozen Grendel alive at Isaac's End in Naris.
t.Reikos: Nekoda of the Shattered Tower was tasked with saving Professor Gelberg from Grendel assassins at Couros Field in Haros Water.
t.Sarangrave: Sarangrave had its own Wind, Thorn and bone, a possible battle to contain the dead in Turan Flats, and the most conjunctions of any territory, including wards, cursing and the vallorn.
t.Skarsind: An Imperial Orc army may take the Forge Hammers order while in Skarsind.
t.Spiral: The Custodian of the Legacy was tasked with intercepting mercenaries' pay at Alba's Lea in Apstrus.
t.Tassato: The Keeper of the Sapphire Stair was tasked with killing heralds of Siakha at Campo Verdenta in Cascatas.
t.The Barrens: The Barrens faced several conjunctions against Druj raiders, Surut's servants, failed knights-errant and Ser Gawain Amboise. Citizen patrols mean the Druj need 25 victory points to claim a beachhead there.
t.Therunin: A Druj miasma pillar was located in Lower Tarn Valley, and Andronikos of the Lighthouse-That-Was was tasked with destroying it.
t.Upwold: Any Imperial army may Billet in Upwold, and the Bounders receive an additional 1000 strength when fighting there.
t.Volodmartz: Auntie Armand Mariyavich Remislav was tasked with destroying the Sumisev Peegel in Livardz.
t.Zenith: Citizens patrol Zenith's borders, so the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead. Highborn and Urizen armies attacking Zenith from Morrow gain bonuses to territory captured.

A horn blast of victory.d: Vesna praised the knights who fought for her against the manticore and pledged to end the Druj. Until the Summer Solstice 389YE, all Dawnish armies could make a triumphant charge against Druj-held regions, but could not take a steady conquest against them. The Northern Eagle had spent the season isolating Lower Saarnath for an Imperial beachhead. Vesna's oath of office was inscribed in the Forge of Bonds. The manticore's surviving vassals and die-hard supporters caused three crises in the Barrens, each offered as a conjunction. The Earl's Council recognised Earl Temperance of the Groves' claim to the manticore's manse, which brings its holder extra materials each season.

n.Dawn: Dawn's pride was stirred by its new queen, letting the Eastern Sky, Golden Sun, Gryphon's Pride and Lions of Adelmar make triumphant charges against the Druj for a year, though not steady conquests. The nation also faced trouble in the Barrens from the manticore's vassals and followers.
n.Druj: The Druj were named as Dawn's ancient enemy, to be destroyed. Their remaining lands in the Salt Flats, Forest of Ulnak and Therunin faced triumphant charges from Dawnish armies for the coming year.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: Vesna commended a list of citizens for taking the first successful steps towards diplomacy with the Jotun.
n.Navarr: Mentioned in passing: Druj-held regions of Therunin, a territory Navarr shared with the Druj, were among those Dawnish armies could charge.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: the Thule push into the Forest of Ulnak was noted as being supported by Imperial mercenaries.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: Vesna commended Andronikos of the Lighthouse-That-Was for his victory in Bloodwater Marsh and Arsenio Sanguineo Rezia di Tassato for his service as Grandmaster of the Golden Pyramid.
n.Varushka: Mentioned in passing: Ossium was listed among the lands taken from the Druj, and Varushkans were noted as understanding the danger of broken oaths.

t.Forest of Ulnak: Its Druj-held regions became targets for Dawnish triumphant charges, alongside the existing Thule push supported by Imperial mercenaries.
t.Ossium: Mentioned in passing: listed as one of the territories wrested from Druj control, leaving the Mallum smaller than ever.
t.Salt Flats of Sanath: Described as the last great Druj territory, heavy with miasma and guarded by ancient fortifications. All its regions were open to Dawnish triumphant charges.
t.Sarangrave: Mentioned in passing: named as newly wrested from Druj control, with a commendation for the victory in Bloodwater Marsh.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: Vesna recalled how Dawn's forebears drove the Ulvenkin from Semmerholm.
t.Therunin: East Ashes, Lower Tarn Valley, Peakedge Song and Upper Tarn Valley, held by the Druj, were open to Dawnish triumphant charges for the year.

r.Forest of Ulnak/Deathsgate: Held by the Druj, Deathsgate was a valid target for Dawnish triumphant charges until Summer 389YE.
r.Forest of Ulnak/Ghul'thak Forest: Ghul'thak Forest was among the Druj regions Dawnish generals could order triumphant charges against for the coming year.
r.Forest of Ulnak/Gloomsea: Gloomsea was open to Dawnish triumphant charges against its Druj holders, and steady conquests there were barred to Dawn.
r.Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire: Grimfen Mire was named as a Druj region where Dawnish armies could make a triumphant charge.
r.Forest of Ulnak/Shifting Basin: Shifting Basin was listed among the Druj-held regions open to Dawnish triumphant charges for the year.
r.Forest of Ulnak/The Bonewall: The Bonewall was a valid target for Dawnish triumphant charges while it remained in Druj hands.
r.Salt Flats of Sanath/Lower Saarnath: The Northern Eagle had spent three months isolating Lower Saarnath from the Druj garrisons, so that an Imperial beachhead could be claimed with little resistance.
r.Sarangrave/Bloodwater Marsh: Mentioned in passing: Vesna commended Andronikos of the Lighthouse-That-Was for his monumental victory in Bloodwater Marsh.
r.Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest: Mentioned in passing: some Gryphon's Pride deserters had left the army when asked to defend Nesustak Forest.
r.Therunin/East Ashes: East Ashes was named among the Druj-held regions where Dawnish armies could make triumphant charges.
r.Therunin/Lower Tarn Valley: Lower Tarn Valley was open to Dawnish triumphant charges against the Druj until Summer 389YE.
r.Therunin/Peakedge Song: Peakedge Song was a Druj-held region Dawnish generals could target with a triumphant charge.
r.Therunin/Upper Tarn Valley: Upper Tarn Valley was listed as a valid target for Dawnish triumphant charges against the Druj.

A lasting commitment.d: Rafael Barossa's statement, upheld with a greater majority, invoked the Hallowing of the Patron. A Synod mandate could spread word that the Grand Inspiration would open as 388YE turned to 389YE; success would inspire the faithful, and failure carries no penalty. The Highborn Assembly proposed seven gardens for the Voices of Virtue, giving each five liao a season and creating the Annals of Virtue. Highborn benefactors also offered the Guildmaster of the Artisans four thrones a season to arrange regalia for the Voices. Further options were residentiary canons or national speakers housed in the edifice, and a choristers balcony if a mandate drew Highborn cantors to Bastion.

n.Highguard: The Highborn Assembly's highest calling now sets the shape of the Grand Inspiration, and a Highguard mandate could revive the nation's cantor tradition with a choristers balcony at its heart, while Nicodemus's Speaker role is proposed as a model for other nations.
n.The League: Mentioned in passing: the Archbishop of Capodomus, Estella Lucati, is listed among existing national titles that could take up offices in the Grand Inspiration.

t.Bastion: Bastion is where the Grand Inspiration is being built. If it is completed by the start of 389YE, all eyes will be on the construction and Bastion could become the heart of the Way, with possible new gardens, offices and a choristers balcony within the edifice.
t.Holberg: Mentioned in passing: the great walls of Holberg are cited as smaller than the Grand Inspiration, the largest commission ever undertaken in the Empire.

A wizard did it.d: The Imperial regio still cannot enhance ritual lore, and territory-scale rituals at the Summer Solstice risk pronounced side effects. Covens of the same nation can still cooperate freely. A Rivers of Life on Mareave turned its northern regions green until the growth died, leaving rare Spring-realm donahorti that could be preserved if Spring magic is cast on Mareave at the Solstice. The same growth destroyed old ruins and the lighthouse above the Bay of Catazar. The mists over Miekarova's Painted Caves are now permanent, angering the Thule. Seers dreamed of Serenus Starsong, Queen Igraine's regio reverted towards Spring, the Navarr song began fading and northern merchants grew suspicious of coins.

n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: old Grendel and Skoura ruins in northern Mareave were swallowed by the Spring-infused growth and collapsed with it.
n.Imperial Orcs: Their territory of Mareave briefly turned verdant, breeding cattle and drakes, and now offers a chance to preserve valuable donahorti if Spring magic is cast there again at the Summer Solstice.
n.Navarr: The magical song by Idwynn Splitroot that echoed along the trods began to fade, though Navarr who embrace it may still feel fierce pride in their oaths and tattoos. Some Navarr merchants have also started demanding coins be laid out before accepting them.
n.Thule: The Thule were angered that the mists over the Painted Caves, in a region ceded to them by treaty, became permanent, and the orcs of Otkodov intend to raise it with Ambassador Kindra Surefoot.
n.Urizen: Abandoned Urizen spires in Icarion were reduced to rubble by the dying growth. Seers also dreamed of Serenus Starsong in a Urizen-style gown, and the Citadel Guard can still channel rituals through the Imperial regio.
n.Varushka: The Painted Caves in Varushkan-held Miekarova are now permanently shrouded, removable only by a magnitude-60 Piercing Light of Revelation with sixty rings of ilium. Some Varushkan merchants have grown suspicious of cash.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark merchants were heard whispering of soot in their purses and insisting on seeing coins before payment, a habit spreading to other northern traders.

t.Bay of Catazar: The ruined lighthouse that had stood for centuries on the cliffs above the bay was torn down by the Spring-infused vegetation, the greatest loss among Mareave's ruins.
t.Mareave: A wayward Rivers of Life made the arid north green for a few months before the growth died, destroying old ruins but leaving short-lived donahorti that farms, herb gardens, mana sites and businesses could harvest if Spring magic is cast on the territory at the Summer Solstice.
t.Miekarova: The enchanted mists around the Painted Caves were bound with ilium and became permanent, requiring a magnitude-60 Piercing Light of Revelation plus sixty rings of ilium to lift.
t.Otkodov: The orcs of Otkodov are deeply unhappy about the permanent shrouding of the Painted Caves and plan to raise it with Ambassador Kindra Surefoot.

r.Mareave/Eoradal: Eoradal's scarce waters filled and greenery briefly spread around lakes and wells, before dying back and dragging nearby ruins down with it.
r.Mareave/Icarion: Icarion saw the worst damage, with its abandoned spires left as rubble covered in scrubby grass and odd yellow and orange flowers.
r.Mareave/Nadir: The fertility surge bred hungry young drakes, and Nadir's hunters did a roaring trade killing them before they could prey on farms and the Great Southern Herd.
r.Mareave/Sinfoyard: Sinfoyard briefly turned green as Rivers of Life filled its waters, bringing unfamiliar fruit and livestock fertility before the growth withered and pulled down old ruins.

All I ask of you.d: The mystagogues learned the little left to know of Great Forest beliefs. The sept also confided two fears: that the Synod might proscribe their faith, and that the Montanian orphans they shelter will one day seek answers from the Empire. Nimon Rue of Cassad Ûln had twice threatened to execute the orcs enslaved at the Sacred Grove and the Grove of Woe. Vallack says he has not replied. The Navarr and Imperial Orc assemblies could each appoint a leader for a venture to Rescue the Great Forest Orcs. Its success would depend on the strength committed, possibly boosted by the Northern Eagle, Winter Sun, Gryphon's Pride, Irra Harah or the Karass, though Karass treachery would weaken it.

n.Dawn: The Gryphon's Pride could station themselves in the Barrens as a logistics hub for the raid, exposed to heavier casualties, as a tangible gesture that might soften Great Forest hostility to the Dawnish. Lady Gwendoloena de Ordraig and Reynard of De Gauvain could also appeal to the Karass for help.
n.Druj: Nimon Rue threatened to impale the enslaved Great Forest Orcs, and the planned raid could strip the Druj of these slaves and of weirwood from the Sacred Grove and the Grove of Woe.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Unshackled Assembly's delegation uncovered the Druj threat. The nation could now appoint a raid leader and commit military units, personal resources and the Winter Sun to rescuing their Great Forest 'cousins'.
n.Navarr: The Navarr, sworn to protect the Great Forest Orcs, could appoint a raid leader and commit units and personal resources to the rescue. Young Great Forest Orcs from Hercynia were also due to visit their camp to offer support for the new armies.
n.Thule: The Thule would allow Imperial armies to join their fight in Ulnak from Oerwealt, but only if they acknowledged Tathenon the Gyre's strategy. Their war has put Cassad Ûln's garrison on high alert.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: the Winter Sun was stationed in the Urizen territory of Zenith.
n.Varushka: The Northern Eagle could order a Strike at the Grove of Woe to aid the raid, though the Great Forest Orcs blame the Varushkans for slaughtering the Montanians at Hope's Rest.

t.Astolat: Mentioned in passing: used to compare how hard it is for Bramblepatch to enter Ulnak with how hard Astolat is for Agramant's heralds.
t.Forest of Ulnak: Hundreds of Great Forest Orcs enslaved at the Sacred Grove faced execution by Nimon Rue of Cassad Ûln, whose huge garrison patrols the territory. The raid, the Winter Sun and a Spring ritual offered ways to free them.
t.Hercynia: Great Forest Orc youths living in Hercynia planned to visit the Navarr camp to discuss supporting the nation and its new armies.
t.Miaren: Small Great Forest Orc communities live in Miaren, and some of their younger members feel less wary of the Empire than their elders.
t.Ossium: Mentioned in passing: Ossium is not named in the text; its only link is indirect, through the involvement of Varushka's Northern Eagle.
t.Otkodov: The Thule invasion of Ulnak was launched from Otkodov, and the Winter Sun could only order Break the Chains by joining that attack.
t.Salt Flats of Sanath: Several thousand Great Forest Orcs enslaved at the Grove of Woe faced execution. Three massive fortifications make the territory hard to raid, though the Northern Eagle was already operating there.
t.Sarangrave: Mentioned in passing: Ser Guy of the Twisted Rose built trust by aiding the anti-Druj insurgents of Nesustak Forest.
t.The Barrens: Rescued Great Forest Orcs would be brought back to the Eaves of Peytaht in the Barrens, where the Gryphon's Pride could stage the raid and the Northern Eagle could retreat to cover the refugees.
t.Therunin: Mentioned in passing: Great Forest Orc communities lived there and suffered heavily fighting beside the Navarr before the Druj conquered it.
t.Zenith: Mentioned in passing: the Winter Sun was in Zenith and would need Find the Best Path to reach the Forest of Ulnak.

r.Forest of Ulnak/Deathsgate: Hundreds of Great Forest Orcs are enslaved at the Sacred Grove near the Deathsgate fortification, and were the main target of the Ulnak raid along with its weirwood.
r.Forest of Ulnak/Grimfen Mire: A Sentinel Gate conjunction to the strong Spring regio of Moss End, guarded by Druj, offered a chance to cast Forge the Wooden Fastness and bring Irra Harah's forces into the raid.
r.Forest of Ulnak/Oerwealt: The Thule-held Oerwealt could serve as a launch point for the Winter Sun, and casting Forge the Wooden Fastness there, possibly with Woodward, would bolster the Thule and let Irra Harah aid the raid.
r.Salt Flats of Sanath/Lower Saarnath: The Northern Eagle had isolated Lower Saarnath, fuelling rumours of a planned Imperial invasion, which gave the army a fleeting chance to strike at the Grove of Woe.
r.Salt Flats of Sanath/Ûrinth: A Northern Eagle strike at the Grove of Woe would trade casualties with the garrison of The Witness in Ûrinth, at an estimated cost of 900 Imperial casualties.
r.Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest: Mentioned in passing: Ser Guy of the Twisted Rose aided the anti-Druj insurgents of Nesustak Forest and built trust there.
r.The Barrens/Hope's Rest: Mentioned in passing: the Northern Eagle slew the Montanians at Hope's Rest, a deed that colours Great Forest attitudes to Varushka.
r.The Barrens/The Bleaks: Mentioned in passing: not named directly; the page refers only to the Barrens generally as the destination for rescued orcs and a staging area.

All laudable qualities.d: Following a Winter 387YE call, the Assembly of Nine appointed Wulfric of the Marches as Symposiarch after he swore an oath in their presence. Sessions on heresy, idolatry, blasphemy, abuse of powers, desecration and other matters were scheduled in Anvil's sodality chamber. Magistrates advised that debating what should be a religious crime is legal, but actually committing a proscribed act would be prosecuted. Magistrate Abraham may attend the opening and two Chief Magistrates will try to be available. The Marcher Assembly invited the Mournwold orcs, whose heretical belief in orc reincarnation the Synod can no longer ignore; Hap the Soft will try to attend. The Assembly of the Way invited the Raboviches of False Hopes and the Hall of the Newborn Sun to represent Lucidianism.

n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: False Hopes was built from the bones of an old Druj logging camp, and the Hall of the Newborn Sun once rewarded efforts to rid Urizen lands of the Druj miasma.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: the Mournwold orcs are noted as having once been Jotun before becoming Marchers.
n.The Marches: Wulfric of the Marches leads the Symposium, and the Marcher Assembly unanimously invited the Mournwold orcs, forcing the Synod to confront the unresolved clash between their reincarnation belief and the Doctrines of Faith that the Marchers promised would be settled later.
n.Urizen: Lucidianism, founded in the spires of Urizen, is to be represented at the Symposium, with the Urizen citadel of the Hall of the Newborn Sun invited and Phocas planning to arrive for the start.
n.Varushka: The Varushkan banner the Raboviches of False Hopes was invited to represent Lucidianism, though they had not yet said whether they would accept.

t.Morrow: Morrow is home to the Hall of the Newborn Sun, the Urizen Lucidian citadel invited to address the Symposium, whose arbiter Aphroias previously secured recognition that Lucidian views were not heretical.
t.Mournwold: The orcs of the Mournwold, whose belief in reincarnation is plainly heretical under the Doctrines, were formally invited to speak, with Hap the Soft intending to attend; a proscription of their belief could only end in bloodshed.
t.Ossium: The Raboviches of False Hopes, an outpost in south-east Drownbark in Ossium, were invited to represent Lucidianism at the Symposium.

Ambassadors of death.d: Kaela offered to discuss patronage of a new Navarr army against the vallorn, but declared the Clarion Call of Ivory and Dust void because the Synod had proscribed joining her Grim Legion. Prospero called in a favour from the Imperial ambassadors and offered Dawn a hearing on founding a magical college. Meraud would meet Ser Drayvana and the Golden Chalice, allowing From the Mouths of Babes one final, altered casting. Roshanwe proposed a chosen title, Beachcomber, a Necropolis edifice and a prismatic ink commission at Starstep. Irra Harah reported aiding the Nesustak rebels, condemned Imperial policy in Sarangrave, and offered a Woodward boon through Forge the Wooden Fastness.

n.Dawn: Prospero offered Earl Galahad Du Besté and up to four Dawnish enchanters a parley on creating a college of magic in Dawn, and Dawnish citizens were expected at Meraud's meeting during the Arcane Colloquium.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: the Nesustak rebels are described as having thrown off the Druj yoke, and Irra Harah offered to protect the folk of the Barrens from war with the Mallum.
n.Highguard: Roshanwe proposed that the Senate build the House on the Shore, apartments for her proposed Beachcomber, at Sanctuary Sands in the Highborn territory of Necropolis, near the proposed Grand Lodge of the Sevenfold Path.
n.Navarr: Kaela invited the Archmage of Winter to parley alongside the General of the Black Thorns, the Senator of Miaren and up to three other Navarr about her patronage of a new Navarr army against the vallorn, with the Grim Legion fighting at its side.
n.The League: League citizens were among those expected at Meraud's informal meeting during the Arcane Colloquium on Saturday.
n.The Marches: Irra Harah offered to help protect Marcher orcs and yeofolk from the Synod if Alderly or Tower March gained the Woodward quality, but warned that the assurance on Forge the Wooden Fastness, tied to the Hare Stone, is deliberately fragile after the destruction of the Protectors Stone he gave the landskeepers.
n.Urizen: Irra Harah condemned the Empire for giving Sarangrave to Urizen rather than its inhabitants, while Roshanwe proposed a prismatic ink commission at Starstep in the Urizen-held territory of Morrow.
n.Wintermark: Mentioned in passing: Irra Harah's herald delivered the message by sitting beside Jorgen of Wintermark at an Anvil food vendor.

t.Astolat: Mentioned in passing: Astolat is not named directly; the nearest link is the Dawnish involvement and Irra Harah's offer of the Woodward boon for forests near the Barrens.
t.Holberg: Mentioned in passing: Richard of Holberg had earlier suggested Starstep as a site for a similar construction.
t.Miaren: Kaela understands that a new Navarr army will be raised in Miaren and invited its senator to her parley on patronage of that army and ending the vallorn.
t.Morrow: Roshanwe offered to draw up a proposal for a prismatic ink commission at Starstep in Morrow, its scale to be guided by a Conclave declaration of acceptance.
t.Mournwold: If Alderly gained the Woodward quality, Irra Harah would be ready to help protect the Marcher orcs and yeofolk of Mournwold from murder at the hands of the Synod.
t.Necropolis: Roshanwe proposed the House on the Shore at Sanctuary Sands, a regio near an abandoned fishing village, giving the Beachcomber three prismatic ink a season if the Conclave approves the title.
t.Sarangrave: Irra Harah's heralds had helped the Nesustak rebels and Imperial soldiers survive the vallorn, and the eternal demanded the Empire return Sarangrave to its native people rather than giving it to Urizen or the Victorious Axis.
t.The Barrens: Irra Harah recalled past Imperial 'liberation' of the Barrens ending in bloodshed, and offered to protect its human and orc folk from war and the vallorn if Farweald or The Bleaks gained the Woodward quality.

r.Morrow/Operus: Starstep in Operus was proposed by Roshanwe as the site of a prismatic ink commission, earlier plans having been ruined by damage from the Scions' invasion.
r.Mournwold/Alderly: Casting Forge the Wooden Fastness with eight rings of ilium on Alderly would grant the Woodward quality, empowering future wards and bringing Irra Harah's aid to Marchers fearing oppression.
r.Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest: Irra Harah's heralds held the wards against the Doom of Terunael in Nesustak Forest, aiding the rebels and Imperial soldiers, though the eternal remains distrustful of Imperial intentions there.
r.The Barrens/Farweald: Farweald was named as a forest where the Woodward quality would see Irra Harah protect the folk of the Barrens from war and the vallorn.
r.The Barrens/The Bleaks: The Bleaks were named as a forest where the Woodward quality would bring Irra Harah's protection to the human and orc folk of the Barrens.
r.Upwold/Tower March: If Tower March gained the Woodward quality, Irra Harah would be ready to help defend the Marcher orcs and yeofolk of Upwold against the Synod should it become necessary.

Any dream will do.d: The Assembly's judgement passed 404-0 and cited Holberg and Apulian as cities that chose to join the League. From the Summer Solstice 388YE until the Summer Solstice 389YE, the Assembly may each season pass one of two competing mandates, each costing 25 liao. One names a non-citizen group within the Empire and a League archetype to lead the approach, with a different group and archetype each time. The other has one League city approach a significant foreign town or city on the Empire's continent. Neither guarantees anyone joins, but each creates closer ties. If both pass in one season, the one with the higher margin applies. No other known species could plausibly join at present.

n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: the League is cautioned that courting Dubhtraig would mean benefiting a Grendel city in the middle of the Empire's war with them.
n.Highguard: Mentioned in passing: Sarvos and Tassato were once Highborn cities that broke away by declaring themselves free cities rather than by rebellion, keeping reasonable relations with their former kin.
n.Navarr: Mentioned in passing: in the accompanying fiction a Navarr named Alcuin rejects a Sarvos bishop's comparison of the League's courtship to the Great Dance.
n.The League: The Assembly's judgement gives the League a year of seasonal mandates to court non-citizen groups within the Empire, led by its archetypes, or foreign cities, led by one of its own cities, in pursuit of new partners. It also stakes a lasting claim to welcome any other sapient species should one ever become available.
n.Wintermark: Mentioned in passing: the hylje are noted as a sapient people who, if they could join any Imperial nation, would surely join Wintermark, though their fluid nature may put them beyond the egregore bond.

t.Holberg: Holberg is held up as proof of the League's success, a city with its own history that joined through friendship with its burghers and is now called the greatest city in the world. It is one of the five cities that could lead an approach to a foreign city.
t.Sarvos: Sarvos is shown as a former Highborn outpost that won independence through diplomacy, and as the founding city of the nation through Aldones di Sarvos. The accompanying scene features one of its bishops eager to recruit new partners.
t.Spiral: Spiral's city of Apulian is cited alongside Holberg as a city that joined the League without being conquered, though not without rancour, and is described as a city of wondrous secrets.
t.Tassato: Tassato is recalled as a former Highborn city that declared itself free without military rebellion, and Barell of Tassato as a founding partner of the League. It is one of the cities that could lead an approach to a foreign city.
t.Temeschwar: Temeschwar is remembered as joining the League peacefully when Maria Ivanova allied with Tassato. The sovereign King Rat, who claims the city's underbelly, is rumoured to be seeking to join the League, a prospect the nation is urged to weigh exceptionally carefully.

r.Tassato/Tassato Mestra: Mentioned in passing: some describe Tassato Mestra and Tassato Regario as a pair of lovers bound in fractious matrimony, as a model for the bonds a League city might forge with a foreign one.
r.Tassato/Tassato Regario: Mentioned in passing: Tassato Regario is paired with Tassato Mestra as lovers in fractious matrimony, an illustration of the marriage-like bonds the League hopes to form.

Archive:Roll of Honour Summer Solstice 3.d: The roll lists each contributing citizen with their nation, home territory and, where given, their banner. The largest entries were for the Citadel Guard and Eastern Sky, drawing heavily on Dawn, Highguard, Urizen, Varushka, Wintermark and the Imperial Orcs. Burning Falcon drew support across Wintermark, the Marches, the Brass Coast, Highguard, Dawn, Navarr and Varushka. More than two dozen citizens, nearly all Wintermark with two Varushkans, backed the Tsirku spy network.
